lines.en: Four legs pace the wet sand
I run along the shoreline
My tail has turned to fin
I trot with my back arched
Water drains from my ears
I make one circuit of the village
I tread over a patch of kelp
I walk with a shiver
I keep close to my owner's feet
I walk the line of the ebbing tide
I slow to sniff the ground
I climb the stone steps from water
I nudge the grass with my nose
I trot steadily on
I walk along the water marks
I dip my nose in the water
I sit down to watch the sea
My ears twitch now and then

lines.zh: 水从我耳朵尖上滴下来
lines.en: Water drips from the tips of my ears
I wait for my owner to call
My nose is pressed to the ground
A low sound sits in my throat
I am most at ease here
I lift my head to sniff the air
My paws shine with wet
I tilt my head to the tide
I chase my own tail once
I lie flat on the stone
I shudder once
My eyes stay on the sea
I smell you before I see you
You carry no smell of the sea

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你袖口的海水味
lines.en: I sniff the seawater on your cuff
My tail wags slowly
What is in your hand
My ears lift toward you
Do you want to pet me

lines.zh: 我鼻子先碰到你的膝盖
lines.en: My nose reaches your knee before I do
I am not very fierce
Try saying my name
I look up, waiting for your hand
My eyes are clouded
You stand far from me
I give one short bark
I whine once from the pain
I tuck my tail and back off
Blood seeps out under my wet fur
That hurt badly
I lick the wound
I lie down to steady myself
My ears flatten to my head
All four legs still hold me
I look toward my owner
I whimper twice

lines.zh: 鱼腥味从你指缝漏出来
lines.en: Fish smell leaks from between your fingers
I sniff at your hand
I sit down and wait
This smell is familiar
I push my head closer
Lower your hand a bit
I swallow once
That looks very good
I try one small bite
I smell fish on it
My tail wags faster

lines.zh: 我尾巴扫着沙，等你再给
lines.en: My tail sweeps the sand while I wait for more
I edge one small step closer
I sit down at your feet
You bumped into me
My paws slid out
We both step apart
You stepped on my paw
I yelp once
I misjudged the distance
Neither of us grips wet ground
I am heavier than I look
I turn away along your side
Water splashes from the impact
I smell one of my own kind
There are other dogs in the sea
We watch each other across the water
I remember my old home
I still have an owner
I cannot explain such things
I only follow the tide
We need no words between us
I have waited for someone on this shore
I remember that hand
I pick up a stick
I carry it back to the shore
I pick up an old fish

lines.zh: 我叼着它，尾巴摇个不停
lines.en: I carry it over, tail wagging the whole way
I bite down and hold
I shake my head to dry it
I bury it in the sand
I am taking this with me
I run off with it
I bring it back to you
Someone walks the shore
My ears swing that way
I stand and fix on you
You stepped onto my shore

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音压不住了
lines.en: The growl in my throat won't stay down
The fur on my back rises
That figure is not familiar
I will bark first
I move that way
I am unsure if you are friend or foe
I circle downwind to catch your scent
Your hand moves; my ears twitch
Step back, and I follow one step
My paws dig at the ground

lines.zh: 你喘气的节奏我数得清
lines.en: I can count the rhythm of your breathing
I flatten myself and inch forward
I do not bark, only watch
Your feet are moving backwards
I close a little more

lines.zh: 你的脚步一慢，我就逼近
lines.en: When your steps slow, I close in
I leap and bite your wrist
I bite and pull backwards
My claws rake your leg
I slam into your knee
I seize your sleeve
I growl as I pull back
I bite and spring away
My teeth leave a mark
I clamp onto your belt
I body-check your leg
I rise on the beach
The tide delivers me ashore
I shake the water from my coat
A wet dog joins the shore
I step onto dry sand
My ears rise first
I walk up from the shallows
I still carry the smell of the sea
I followed prints to this place
My shadow falls on the tideline
Fire hisses on my wet fur
I roll over on landing
I sink, all four legs thrashing
The blast throws me into the water
An arrow grazes my ribs
Magic makes my fur crackle
Too hungry to stand steady
Lightning stings worst on wet fur
I fall barking
